findings.title: Off-by-one: free shipping threshold changed from >= to >
findings.explanation: Changes free-shipping boundary from inclusive (>=) to exclusive (>). A subtotal exactly equal to FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD (50.00) now incorrectly incurs FLAT_FEE, contradicting original spec.

evidence.why: Changed inclusive >= check to exclusive > so $50.00 no longer gets free shipping.

findings.suggestion: Restore inclusive check: `if subtotal >= FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD:` and update docstring to (>=).
